race.comment: The penny has dropped for BARBRAY (4) who has put back-to-back wins together and is racing high on confidence of late. Winning rider Bayliss retains the mount and should be right there when the whips are cracking again. GORBACHEV (2) is one from one over this course and distance and get some weight relief with the 1.5kg claim. Include in calculations. BLUEPINOT (5) has won two from four around this circuit and will find this easier than recent Saturday metro outings. Watch for a spike in form. LOVEY DOVEY (6) has a win and a placing from two second-up attempts and can feature with any luck in running. VIXENETTE (9) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
